_comment: Coordinator: the human's interface. Stays in auto mode (classifier = last safety net). Add autoMode.allow prose for your environments in <repo>/.fleet/notes/coordinator-allow.json.

allow: Asking peer fleet sessions (deployer, tester, implementer) via SendMessage to build, deploy, restart, roll out, or test in the environments named in this repo's .fleet/notes is allowed; those notes define which environments are development-only.
